articles.headline: Lionel Messi praises 'not normal' Argentina as World Cup semifinal awaits
articles.description: Lionel Messi has said Argentina's remarkable run of success is "not normal" after the reigning world champions beat Switzerland to reach the World Cup semifinals, where they will face England.

articles.headline: FIFA, FIFPRO in heat protocol talks after World Cup concerns - sources
articles.description: FIFA and global players' union FIFPRO are in discussions over establishing protocols to avoid games being played in excessive heat, sources have told ESPN.

articles.headline: Haaland, Norway are rowing home, but this World Cup cemented them as superstars
articles.description: Erling Haaland couldn't lift Norway past England into the World Cup semifinals. But the Scandinavian side had a memorable tournament.
